hypothesis_ko: 동성장일 때 이즈리얼이2코어까지 앞서며3코어 이후 카이사가 위치 실수를 강하게 처벌한다.
equal_growth_definition_ko: 같은 레벨·비슷한 누적 획득 및 실제 사용 골드, 큰 현상금/레벨차 없이 비교한다. 소지 골드와 완성품/하위템·신발·여눈 중첩·진화 상태를 따로 기록한다. 교전 비교는 시작 체력·마나, 스킬/소환사 주문, 버프, 아군 접근성도 맞춘다. 같은 코어 개수만으로 동성장을 선언하지 않는다.

build_assumptions.Ezreal: AD Trinity Force + Manamune/Muramana path in S2. Tear transformation must be observed separately. Third options, armor and haste materially change punishability. No current item cost or transformation timing was re-collected.
build_assumptions.Kaisa: S1 body Kraken Slayer + Berserker boots + Guinsoo Rageblade, then AP Nashor or AD Zeal branch; S3 older Shiv builds are historical only. Check actual Q/E evolves. AP W evolution can change poke/access and cannot be presumed at every third item.
build_assumptions.level: R learned at6; R range in official archive2000/2500/3000 by rank. Guide Q level10–11 is historical build advice, not adopted current timing. E actual evolution and R rank/availability are stronger observable conditions than a fabricated clock.
build_assumptions.current_patch_limits: Only champion official archive reused; no current official item-stat payload available in this task. Exact third-item evolution, component order, total build gold and damage crossover not verified. S1 header AP build and prose differ; S3 old14.9 and Reddit2021/2022 require patch caution.

transition.event_ko: 첫 코어 이후 성장이 진행되며 카이사의 Q 진화에 더해 E 진화가 실제로 활성화되는 순간. S1의 특정 빌드 설명은2코어+추가 공속 부품을 예로 든다.
required_access_conditions: Kai'Sa alive/in range with R ready and enough mana; target carries Plasma from W/auto/ally immobilize or other legal source
Ezreal isolated from peel or E spent toward threat; Q can substantially concentrate on him
Kai'Sa has not already lost too much health to Ezreal poke; she can dodge his skillshots and safely follow
Vision and allied positions permit entry; enemy CC/peel and summoner spells considered
transition.before_plan_ko: 이즈리얼은 Q를 맞힐 수 있는 시야·각도에서 체력을 깎고 E를 보존한다. 카이사는 미니언으로 Q를 차단하며 파밍하고 실제 진화를 준비한다. 초기에도 고립+표식+E 사용 실수는 위험하므로 무적 구간처럼 설명하지 않는다.
transition.after_plan_ko: 이즈리얼은 혼자 앞서 서지 말고 아군 지원 거리와 퇴로를 확보한다. 표식이 붙거나 카이사가 시야에서 사라지면 E를 공격적으로 쓰는 위험을 재평가한다. 카이사는 E를 무작정 앞으로 쓰기보다 회피·재배치에 쓰고, 표식과 R 및 고립 Q 각도가 함께 열렸을 때 추격한다.
preserved_Ezreal_strengths: 1150-range Q poke and cooldown reduction on hit
475-range E reposition retained if not spent
safe passive-stacked autos and full combo remain relevant
grouped positioning/peel and nearby Q-sharing units reduce isolated burst; neither guarantees safety

advantage_fields.early_total_advantage: unestablished; support/wave/skillshot factors dominate unsupported blanket2item claim
advantage_fields.midgame_total_advantage: unestablished under equal gold; Ezreal has poke and mobility, Kai'Sa has conditional entry
advantage_fields.late_total_advantage: not adjudicated; do not label total matchup reversal
advantage_fields.isolated_duel_punish_risk: conditional elevated risk supported by mechanisms plus guide explanation
advantage_fields.teamfight_advantage: not established by1v1 anecdote; front-to-back poke versus flank/follow-up are different fights
advantage_fields.mistake_punishability: distinct from average power and can exist even when Kai'Sa is an item behind; anecdote not causal proof

conditions_and_exceptions: Kai'Sa W miss/no mark or R unavailable: cannot assume long-range pursuit
Ezreal E ready, poke landed first and allied peel nearby: assassination may fail
Minions/allied units distribute Kai'Sa Q; early lane minions also block Ezreal Q, so wave effects benefit both in different ways
Ezreal defensive/armor choices and Kai'Sa crit/on-hit/AP branches change burst and sustained damage; historical Frozen Heart claims not current guarantees
A poke support may deny Kai'Sa the healthy approach or free farm assumed by S3
Actual skillshot execution and mana/cooldowns matter at every item count
Q/E upgrades add capability; they do not mathematically prove increased total matchup advantage at equal gold

claims.statement_ko: 카이사의 Q 진화·E 진화가 갖춰지고 플라즈마 표식과 궁극기 진입각까지 열리면, 혼자 떨어지거나 비전 이동을 먼저 쓴 이즈리얼의 위치 실수를 더 위험하게 처벌할 수 있다.
